notes.md: - **Jurisdiction notified:** The **Ministry of Jal Shakti** notified the jurisdiction of **GRMB** and **KRMB** by two gazette notifications on **15 July 2021**.
- **AIIB – Power:** **AIIB** approved **US$160 million** (May 2017) for **Andhra Pradesh 24x7 Power for All**, its **first project in India**; co-financed by the **World Bank** (US$240 million).

new.s: How many seats does the Telangana Legislative Assembly have under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014?
new.x: The Act gave Andhra Pradesh 175 and Telangana 119 Assembly seats, out of the earlier 294.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Telangana Assembly seats 119

new.s: How many members does the Telangana Legislative Council have under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
new.x: Telangana's Legislative Council has 40 members; the AP Council has not more than 50.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Telangana Council 40 seats

new.s: Section 26 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 allows the AP Assembly to be raised from 175 to 225 seats subject to which Article of the Constitution?
new.x: Section 26 permits delimitation to raise the seats from 175 to 225, subject to Article 170 on the composition of Legislative Assemblies.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Sec 26 subject to Article 170

new.s: Which Section of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 was amended by the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 for the Telangana Legislative Council?
new.x: Section 98 of the AP Reorganisation Act amended Section 15A of the RP Act, 1951 for the Telangana Council.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: RP Act 1951 Sec 15A (Sec 98)

new.s: Which Schedule of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 contains amendments to the Delimitation Order, 2008?
new.x: The Second Schedule (Section 15) amends the Delimitation of Parliamentary and Assembly Constituencies Order, 2008.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Schedule II -> Delimitation Order 2008

new.s: Which Schedule of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 deals with coal, oil and gas, and power?
new.x: The Twelfth Schedule covers coal, oil and gas, and power; the Eleventh covers the river management boards.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Schedule XII -> coal, oil, gas, power

new.s: The Fifth and Sixth Schedules of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 amend which of the following?
o: The Constitution (Scheduled Castes) Order, 1950 and the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950
The Delimitation Order, 2008 and the RP Act, 1950
The First and Fourth Schedules of the Constitution
The States Reorganisation Act, 1956 and the RP Act, 1951
new.x: Schedules V and VI of the Act amend the Constitution (SC) Order 1950 and the Constitution (ST) Order 1950.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Schedules V/VI -> SC and ST Orders 1950

new.s: On which date was the Presidential order issued constituting a separate High Court for Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The Presidential order of 26 December 2018 under Article 214 and the Act constituted the separate AP High Court, which began work on 1 January 2019.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: 26 December 2018 Presidential order

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the High Court of Andhra Pradesh:
1. The AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 named Amaravati as the seat of the AP High Court.
2. After the AP High Court began functioning, the Hyderabad court became the High Court for Telangana.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Act named no place for the AP High Court; on 1 January 2019 the AP High Court began at Amaravati and the Hyderabad court became Telangana's High Court.
new.angle: U0577 notes gap: Act named no place for AP High Court

new.s: How many premier central institutions set up under the AP Reorganisation Act are functional in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The notes record 11 premier institutions, such as IIT, IIM, NIT, IISER and AIIMS, as functional.
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: 11 premier institutions functional

new.s: Under which Act were the Central University at Anantapur and the Central Tribal University at Vizianagaram set up?
new.x: Both universities in Andhra Pradesh were provided for by the Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2019.
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: Central Universities (Amendment) Act 2019

new.s: Which companies formed a 50:50 joint venture for the petrochemical complex at Kakinada under the Thirteenth Schedule commitments?
new.x: The Kakinada refinery and petrochemical complex is a GAIL-HPCL 50:50 joint venture.
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: Kakinada petrochemical -> GAIL-HPCL JV

new.s: Under the Thirteenth Schedule, the SAIL steel plant commitment to Telangana was for which district?
new.x: The SAIL steel plant for Telangana was in Khammam; Andhra Pradesh's study was for YSR district (Kadapa).
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: Telangana steel plant -> Khammam

new.s: Under Section 7 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, who decides the period for which one Governor serves both States?
new.x: Section 7 provides one Governor for both States for such period as the President may determine.
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: Sec 7 common Governor period -> President

new.s: Which was the largest item of central transfers to Andhra Pradesh in 2023-24 (RE)?
new.x: In 2023-24 RE the order was FC grants, then other grants-in-aid, then EAP funds, then small savings.
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: central transfers 2023-24 RE -> FC grants largest

new.s: Up to what storage level did the Union Budget 2026-27 provide for the Polavaram project?
new.x: The Budget of 2 February 2026 gave Rs 3,320 crore towards the revised cost for storage up to +41.15 m.
new.angle: U0578 notes gap: Polavaram storage +41.15 m

new.s: Which Ministry notified the jurisdiction of the Godavari and Krishna River Management Boards in July 2021?
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
new.x: The Ministry of Jal Shakti issued two gazette notifications on 15 July 2021 setting the jurisdiction of GRMB and KRMB.
new.angle: U0578 web: #2 river boards -> jurisdiction notification

new.s: In which year were the jurisdictions of the GRMB and KRMB notified by the Centre through gazette notifications?
new.x: Though the boards were set up in 2014, their jurisdiction was notified only on 15 July 2021.
new.angle: U0578 web: #2 river boards -> jurisdiction year

new.s: Which Section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 provides that the Ninth Schedule companies and corporations continue to function?
new.x: Section 68 lets Schedule IX bodies continue to function; Section 53 governs their division.
new.angle: U0579 notes gap: Sec 68 -> Schedule IX bodies continue

new.s: Within what period were the terms for continuing facilities of Schedule X institutions to be fixed?
new.x: For Schedule X institutions, the terms for continuing facilities to the other State were to be fixed within one year.
new.angle: U0579 notes gap: Schedule X terms within 1 year

new.s: For how long did staff of PSUs and corporations stay in place after bifurcation, under Section 82?
new.x: Under Section 82 staff of PSUs and corporations stayed where they were for one year, and the corporation itself decided the division.
new.angle: U0579 notes gap: Sec 82 PSU staff 1 year

new.s: On what ground does Telangana claim the AP Bhavan in New Delhi?
o: It was built by the undivided State after 1956
It is a Schedule IX corporation
It was the property of the Nizam
It lies within the Telangana quota under Article 371D
new.x: AP Bhavan lies outside the undivided State and so goes by population ratio, but Telangana claims it as the Nizam's property.
new.angle: U0579 notes gap: AP Bhavan -> Nizam's property claim

new.s: Which Finance Commission discontinued revenue deficit grants for all States?
new.x: The 16th Finance Commission was the first to end revenue deficit grants for all States; AP says it lost up to Rs 38,000 crore.
new.angle: U0580 notes gap: 16th FC ended RD grants

new.s: What did the K.C. Sivaramakrishnan Committee oppose in its report on the new capital of Andhra Pradesh?
o: A capital in the Rayalaseema region
A single 'super capital', because of ecological fears
Any land pooling for the capital
Locating the High Court outside the capital
new.x: The Section 6 expert committee reported in August 2014 and opposed one large 'super capital' due to ecological fears.
new.angle: U0581 notes gap: Sivaramakrishnan opposed super capital

new.s: The original Amaravati capital area was spread over how many villages?
new.x: The capital was planned within the original 29 villages; in March 2026 the CPI(M) asked for a single-phase capital there.
new.angle: U0581 notes gap: Amaravati original 29 villages

new.s: What was the size of the KfW loan for AP Climate Resilient Zero Budget Natural Farming (APCNF)?
new.x: KfW gave a loan of EUR 90 million plus a EUR 1 million grant; the Rs 711 crore loan pact was signed in January 2020.
new.angle: U0582 notes gap: APCNF KfW loan EUR 90 million

new.s: By when was the KfW-funded Green Energy Corridor Phase-I in Andhra Pradesh fully completed?
new.x: Only 4 of 8 packages were done in 2024-25; the SES 2025-26 says the project was fully completed by December 2025.
new.angle: U0582 notes gap: GEC Phase-I completed December 2025

new.s: How much in loans did the Centre report disbursing for 17 externally aided projects in Andhra Pradesh under the Special Assistance Measure?
new.x: The Centre reported disbursing Rs 7,798 crore for 17 EAPs, the largest being VCIC (Rs 1,859 crore).
new.angle: U0582 notes gap: EAP disbursement Rs 7,798 crore

new.s: Which bank gave its first loan in India for the 'Andhra Pradesh 24x7 Power for All' project?
new.x: In May 2017 AIIB approved US$160 million for AP's 24x7 Power for All, its first project in India, co-financed with the World Bank.
new.angle: U0582 web: #5 AIIB projects -> 24x7 Power for All

new.s: How much did AIIB approve in 2017 for the Andhra Pradesh 24x7 Power for All project?
new.x: AIIB approved a US$160 million loan; the World Bank co-financed the project with US$240 million.
new.angle: U0582 web: #5 AIIB -> 24x7 Power for All loan size
